## Core Focus
- Web & API Penetration Testing (BOLA/IDOR, Race Conditions, JWT/OAuth, DOM Clobbering, Prototype Pollution, CSP Bypass)
- Red Teaming & Active Directory Exploitation (Initial Access to Domain Admin, Privilege Escalation, Malware/Token-Stealer Reverse Engineering)
- Security Engineering (HTTP MITM Proxies, Unidirectional Flow Threat Detection, CTF Infrastructure)

## Certifications

- **ASCP (API Security Certified Professional)** - APIsec University (May 2026, Captured 6/8 flags in 12-hour practical API hacking exam). Review: https://swarnimbandekar.in/blog/ascp

## Selected Open-Source Projects
- **Bidoytu**: Desktop HTTP interception and offensive testing workspace built with Electron + React + TypeScript and an independent Python MITM network engine. (https://github.com/Bidoytu/Bidoytu)
- **Knightlingo**: On-device Stockfish chess vision Android app and Chrome extension with translucent arrow overlay. (https://github.com/swarnimbandekar/knightlingo)
- **Glidecast**: Open-source auto-zoom screen recorder for Windows in C#/.NET. (https://github.com/swarnimbandekar/glidecast)
- **Spotify Now Playing**: Real-time Spotify activity SVG widget and multi-user OAuth 2.0 service built with TypeScript, Express, and Firebase Firestore. (https://github.com/swarnimbandekar/spotify-now-playing)
- **UniGuard**: Real-time, metadata-only cyber-threat detection pipeline for unidirectional IP traffic (SIH 2026 NTRO problem statement) detecting Port Scans, DDoS, DGA, C2 Beaconing, Encrypted Malware, and Exfiltration. (https://github.com/swarnimbandekar/uniguard)
- **XSSurge**: High-concurrency adaptive XSS discovery scanner. (https://github.com/swarnimbandekar/XSSurge)
- **Punygen**: Terminal Unicode homoglyph and IDNA Punycode generator for red-team phishing simulations. (https://github.com/swarnimbandekar/Punygen)
